ruleDefinitions.name: Active Directory Structure Export Via Ldifde.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "ldifde.exe" in order to export organizational Active Directory structure.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\ldifde\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ldifde\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-f.*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i.*"))
